newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: South Asian port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: South Asian port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BANGLADESH, March 18 - Chittagong - Port employees union suspended all operations for an indefinite period from 1200 15/3. Negotiations taking place between the union and the authorities. 26 Vessels in port of which 5 containers, 6 general cargo, 2 cement, 2 fertiliser, 4 food grain, 1 tanker, 1 rape seed, 2 cement clinker, 3 under repair. 25 Vessels due by 25/3 of which 11 containers, 2 general cargo, 2 car carriers, 2 cement, 1 fertiliser, 1 tug, 2 food grain, 2 tankers, 2 for scraping.

INDIA, March 18 - Muai - No labour problems. Six vessels loading at berth, 18 discharging at berth, 1 discharging at anchorage. 4 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 5 waiting to discharge, 2 under repair, 1 awaiting orders. Delays expected, containers/general cargo vessels 1-2 days, bulkers 5-6 days. Calcutta - Six vessels loading at berth, 12 discharging at berth, 1 bunkering. 21 Vessels due (3 coking coal, 9 products tankers, 6 containers, 2 general cargo, 1 steel). Cochin - No labour problems. Two vessels loading at berth, 7 discharging at berth, 4 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 tug, 1 small vessel dry-docked. 13 Vessels due with up to 1 day delay expected.

Chennai (Madras) - No labour problems. Nine vessels discharging at berth, 5 waiting at anchorage to discharge, 1 dredger dry-docked/under repair. 40 Vessels due of which 13 general cargo, 5 coal, 12 containers, 4 fertiliser, 1 edible oil, 1 scrap, 1 sugar, 2 molasses, 1 iron ore. Mormugao - No labour problems. Two vessels loading at berth, 2 loading at anchor, 1 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting to discharge. 1 Vessel under repair/dry-docked, 1 awaiting orders. 10 Vessels due (8 ore, 1 mop, 1 cement) with following delays, ore 4-5 days, no delays for mop/cement.

Kandla - Six vessels loading at berth, 3 discharging at berth, 4 waiting at anchorage to load, 2 waiting at anchorage to discharge. 4 Vessels under arrest, 3 tankers, 20 vessels waiting. Mangalore - No labour problems. Five vessels loading/discharging at berth, 5 awaiting berths, 1 under arrest, 9 due with 2-3 days delay expected. Jawaharlal Nehru - No labour problems. Two vessels discharging at berth (1 fertiliser/raw material, 1 tanker/iron ore vessel). 6 Vessels due of which 2 food grain, 4 tankers/iron ore vessels. Paradip - No labour problems. Four vessels loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth, 5 waiting at anchorage to load, 3 waiting at anchore to discharge. 28 Vessels due (4 coal, 2 chrome, 2 iron, 18 oil, 2 gas,chemicals), with 2 days delay expected.

Tuticorin - No labour problems. Four vessels loading at berth, 4 discharging at berth, 6 waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting at anchorage to discharge. 1 Vessel under repair/dry-docked, 5 due with 1-2 days delay expected at present. Visakhapatnam - No labour problems. Three vessels loading at berth, 9 discharging at berth, 3 waiting at anchor to dischge at inner harbour berth, 6 waiting at anchor to load at inner harbour berth. 16 Vessels due with 7-8 days delay expected.

PAKISTAN, March 17 - Karachi - Seven rice vessels loading at berth, 2 container vessels loading/discharging. 11 Vessels discharging at berth (dap,anchorage to load. 5 Vessels (urea, palm oil) waiting at anchorage to discharge. 1 Vessel bunkering, 3 awaiting orders/crew change. 7 Vessels due with following delays, containers/general cargo 24 hours, fertiliser 22 days, tankers 2 days. Port Qasim - March 15 - One rice vessel loading at berth, 2 wheat vessels discharging at berth. 6 Vessels waiting at anchorage to discharge (wheat, sugar, fuel oil, palm oil, soya bean oil). 3 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load (rice, crude oil).

SRI LANKA, March 18 - Colombo - No labour problems. 15 Vessels loading at berth (2 essential services, 12 containers, 1 tea on pallets). 20 Discharging at berth (1 bagged sugar, 11 containers, 1 bulk cement, 1 bulk tallow, 1 bagged cement, 1 bagged onions, 1 bagged onions/sugar, 3 general cargo). 7 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load (6 containers, 1 bagged cement). 6 Container vessels waiting to discharge, 3 vessels bunkering, 2 under repair, 1 dry-docked. 6 Vessels awaiting orders, 4 due (3 containers, 1 general cargo) with 24 hours delay expected for conventional/container vessels. Galle - Two vessels discharging at berth. Trincomalee - One vessel discharging at berth, 1 loading at berth.
